To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the field of interaction design is not a new discipline, but is a combination of existing disciplines, and 2) interaction design is not just about designing interfaces, it is also about designing the interaction that takes place within the system.

Interaction designers need to be aware of the fact that the user interface of a product or system is a social interface and not just a technical interface, and that they should take this into consideration when developing a user interface.
the interaction design process can be described as a series of overlapping phases that can be divided into two main stages: the conceptual stage and the implementation stage.
